output.subject: Re: Phishing text
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for taking the time to let us know about the text message you received. You told us it claimed to be an alert about an unusual sign-in and included a link to log in, and that you did not click it. You also mentioned that you have not seen any money missing. We appreciate you passing this on, as reports like yours help us understand how people may be trying to impersonate us.

We have shared the details you sent with our Fraud & Disputes team, who will review them. We will respond to you within 10 business days.

In the meantime, if you notice anything on your account that you don't recognize, or receive any further messages like this one, please let us know.

Thank you again for looking out for yourself and for other customers.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: This is a report of a suspected phishing text, not a complaint; the customer made no request beyond making the bank aware.
Decide whether to add the bank's official guidance on how it contacts customers and how to report suspicious messages.
Decide whether to ask the customer to forward the text or provide the sender's number or a screenshot.
Consider checking the customer's account for any unusual sign-in or activity before sending.
Confirm whether a follow-up response within 10 business days is actually needed, or adjust that line to suit how these reports are handled.
